xml_structure: <e-flexbox configuration-id="Contact hero"><e-div-block configuration-id="Hero ring large"></e-div-block><e-div-block configuration-id="Hero ring small"></e-div-block><e-flexbox configuration-id="Hero content"><e-paragraph configuration-id="Hero breadcrumb"></e-paragraph><e-heading configuration-id="Hero title"></e-heading><e-div-block configuration-id="Hero rule"></e-div-block><e-paragraph configuration-id="Hero lead"></e-paragraph></e-flexbox></e-flexbox>

Hero lead.paragraph: Planning an opening, refreshing an outlet or looking for a specific product? Our team in Dubai is ready to help.

style.Contact hero: position: relative; overflow: hidden; min-height: 560px; padding: 162px max(40px, calc((100% - 1350px) / 2)) 120px max(40px, calc((100% - 1350px) / 2)); flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-start; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(7,31,68,0.96) 0%, rgba(11,47,98,0.78) 55%, rgba(11,47,98,0.3) 100%), url(https://soharon.co.uk/onora/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/contact-hero-tableware.jpg) center / cover no-repeat, #0B2F62; @media(--tablet){ min-height: 480px; padding: 120px 40px 100px 40px; } @media(--mobile){ min-height: 0px; padding: 80px 20px 72px 20px; }
style.Hero ring large: position: absolute; top: -120px; left: 980px; width: 620px; height: 620px; min-width: 620px; padding: 0px; border: 1.2px solid rgba(222,175,87,0.45); border-radius: 50%; @media(--tablet){ left: auto; right: -260px; } @media(--mobile){ display: none; }
style.Hero ring small: position: absolute; top: -45px; left: 1055px; width: 470px; height: 470px; min-width: 470px; padding: 0px; border: 1px solid rgba(222,175,87,0.25); border-radius: 50%; @media(--tablet){ left: auto; right: -185px; } @media(--mobile){ display: none; }
style.Hero content: position: relative; z-index: 2; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; padding: 0px; max-width: 780px; align-items: flex-start;
style.Hero breadcrumb: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
style.Hero title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 88px; line-height: 88px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; color: #FFFFFF; @media(--tablet){ font-size: 68px; line-height: 70px; } @media(--mobile){ font-size: 46px; line-height: 50px; }
style.Hero rule: width: 90px; min-width: 90px; height: 2px; padding: 0px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%);
style.Hero lead: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 17px; line-height: 30px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.82); max-width: 560px; @media(--mobile){ font-size: 15px; line-height: 26px; }
